bitcoin_articles.headline: Hilbert Group Integrates Enigma Statistical Arbitrage into Flagship Bitcoin Fund
bitcoin_articles.summary: Hilbert Group has allocated 5% of its Hilbert Basis+ Fund's Bitcoin assets under management to the Enigma Stat Arb strategy, marking a key integration milestone.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Tether Expands Investment Portfolio into Bitdeer and Other Industrial Sectors
bitcoin_articles.summary: Stablecoin issuer Tether has disclosed a $4.8 billion investment portfolio across 13 U.S. companies, including a strategic stake in Bitdeer Technologies Group to support its expansion into Bitcoin mining.
